recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle, cinematic portrait of a man in a leather jacket set against a monolithic brutalist building at night, characterized by a sharp orange-to-teal color grade and high-contrast specular highlights.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm orange light on the subject versus cool teal ambient sky
Sharp geometric architecture framing the organic human form
Glistening specular highlights on leather and jewelry against matte shadows
Low-angle perspective creating a sense of stature and presence
coreInvariants: Brutalist architectural background with sharp diagonal edges
Star-filter effect on bright specular points

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium shot, subject occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, illuminated by a warm, directional light source.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the illuminated face, follows the vertical line of the jacket buttons, and moves upward along the diagonal lines of the building into the sky.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, textured sky in the upper third, providing room for typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep teal and charcoal (shadows and sky)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant amber/orange (key light and skin tones)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between dark, desaturated backgrounds and saturated, warm highlights.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid pure blacks; use deep teal-tinted shadows
Limit palette to complementary orange and teal spectrums

letterConstructionRules: Variable line weight with visible texture
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Organic, raw lettering to contrast the rigid, geometric architecture.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the raw, textured energy of the image.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-angle photograph of a man in a black leather jacket standing in front of a dark, monolithic brutalist building at night. Use orange key lighting on his face and teal ambient lighting for the sky. Add heavy film grain and star-shaped glints on the jacket buttons and necklace.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply hand-drawn, textured script lettering in the top corners using a semi-transparent off-white color. The lettering should have a dry-brush texture and a slight upward slant.

verificationChecks: Is the color grade strictly orange and teal?
Does the building have sharp, diagonal geometric edges?
Is the film grain prominent across the entire frame?
Do the highlights on the jacket have a star-filter effect?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the orange key light
Angle of the brutalist building's perspective
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Specific brand logos or text content
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the subject's face is the primary focal point.
Check that the teal shadows do not crush into pure black.
Verify the script lettering feels integrated into the grain of the image.
Confirm the low-angle perspective is maintained.
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-angle nocturnal portrait + Brutalist geometry + Orange/Teal color grade + Textured script typography.
